dialect.detail: DECsystem-10 / PDP-10 COBOL (COBOL-10), compiled 4-JUN-73. Uses RECORDING MODE IS ASCII, VALUE OF IDENTIFICATION, REMARKS paragraph, and 77-level COMPUTATIONAL items without COMP-3 — all characteristic of DEC COBOL-10. Program listing format with line numbers and page headers embedded in the source.

purpose.domain_detail: FAA (Federal Aviation Administration) Western Region — SIP-6 card input validation and batch listing program for facility/equipment inventory transactions
purpose.summary: Validates SIP-6 card input records for FAA Western Region facility equipment data, checks for coding errors, and produces a batch listing report showing transaction details and totals (increases/decreases by document, batch, and region). Written by FAA Western Region Programming Staff in 1972-1973.

notable_features: RECORDING MODE IS ASCII (DEC-specific FILE-CONTROL clause)
VALUE OF IDENTIFICATION IS (COBOL-68/74 label value clause)
Compiler listing format embedded in source (line numbers, page headers, sequence numbers)
No COMP-3 usage — all arithmetic fields use COMPUTATIONAL
REDEFINES used extensively for report line layouts
CR edit symbol in PICTURE clauses (e.g., ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.ZZCR)
